1.0.0.en: Initial release with support for ZG-303Z Soil Moisture Sensor. Features soil moisture, temperature, humidity, battery level, and water shortage alarm.

1.0.6.en: Add ZG-222Z water leak sensor driver

1.0.7.en: Add experimental AOYAN AY-303Z soil sensor support with device-specific alarm and temperature-unit datapoints.

1.0.8.en: Add ZG-204ZX presence sensor support, improve Tuya settings communication and retry handling, and fix AY-303Z dry-soil alarm handling.

1.0.9.en: Remove the experimental label from AY-303Z support after successful testing on three units. Refresh the app artwork and listing description to reflect supported Hobeian Zigbee sensors.

1.0.10.en: Improve AY-303Z and ZG-303Z settings delivery: retry failed changes after wake-up, preserve pending changes across app restarts, and add diagnostics for requested and sensor-reported settings. Includes refreshed app descriptions and device photos.
